title: Austin Officials Accept New Year's Ball Invite
summary:
• **New Year's Celebration**: City officials accepted an invitation from East Austin Hose Co. No. 4 to attend their Annual New Year's Ball on January 1st, 1900, marking the turn of the century.

• **Sidewalk Expansion Request**: Citizens petitioned to widen sidewalks on both sides of East 12th Street between Lavaca and Rio Grande Streets; the request was referred to the Street Committee for review.

• **Quorum Problems**: The council struggled to maintain a quorum across two meetings (December 20-21), with only 3 of 7 aldermen present on the second day, forcing the marshal to attempt to round up absent members.

council.

Read and referred to the Street Committee.
